title: Valeria Experience 8523 NDE 8523
content: I was in a very well-lit place together with other persons in a festive and joyful atmosphere. I had no recollection of a life on this earth. I only felt a great feeling of wellness and freedom. Then I heard an inner voice telling me that I must go away. So I was determined to leave. I tried to leave that party without being noticed. One of the persons saw me and asked me, 'Are you going?' I answered, 'I must go.' With a worried look, he replied, 'If you have to, go . . .' In front of me there were many doors. I didn't know which one to choose. Eventually, I chose one and got into it. I was in a tunnel that was full of colors. I was moving at an impressive speed rate. I remember the moment I entered into my brain and I said, 'Oh no! I am back here!' The opening within me closed up and there was no way to go back. I realized that the mind is a claustrophobic and painful prison. I understood that consciousness and brain are two different things. Emotions belong to the brain and not to the soul. The feeling of being restrained was truly claustrophobic. Then I said to myself, 'Now I need to understand what I must do.' I went towards my eyes, where I could feel a dim light. I woke up outside the surgery room and I took to cry ceaselessly, like newborns into this world do. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: July 2014 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related. Other: Total anaesthesia. I was having surgery for a cancer to my left breast. How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? No I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I had a feeling of total wellness and freedom. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Everything was very vivid. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I had visions of total wellness Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Nothing relevant. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes I crossed the tunnel downward, at a very high speed. It was very colorful; full of colorful orange and red. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Very intense, and like I had never seen on earth. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. It was a big party. What emotions did you feel during the experience? I felt like I was in the shoes of God. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Other Christian Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Other Christian Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? Yes. It seemed to me that I was at home, that place has been my home since ever. During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes We were all within the light of wellness Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. I have no fear of death. In times of fear or discomfort, I think about those moments I lived. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I need not the others to feel good After the NDE: How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I do not know how my remembrance of the experience compares to my remembrance of other life events. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? No Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes One year later. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. All was real, not like when you dream and forget. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

environment.environment_other_detail: A very well-lit place described as a "big party" with a festive and joyful atmosphere; tunnel was "full of colors" (orange and red).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Total anaesthesia; surgery for cancer to left breast.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Festive party setting with many doors; inner voice told her she "must go"; return described as re-entering brain/mind as a claustrophobic prison.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Arrival into a party-like realm preceded the tunnel; then rapid tunnel movement and return into the brain/body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: No recollection of earthly life while in the party; many doors to choose from; explicit contrast between consciousness and brain ("mind is a claustrophobic and painful prison").
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Oh no! I am back here!"; "I realized that the mind is a claustrophobic and painful prison."; "It seemed to me that I was at home, that place has been my home since ever."
